paper_id: PATCH_ Empowering Large Language Model with Programmer-Intent Guidance and Collaborative-Behavior Simulation for Automatic Bug Fixing
title: PATCH: Empowering Large Language Model with Programmer-Intent Guidance and Collaborative-Behavior Simulation for Automatic Bug Fixing
venue: ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology
motivation: LLM-based bug fixing忽略协同行为,仅用buggy snippet作为输入,无法处理跨文件依赖和复杂嵌套结构
problem_framing: 将bug修复视为单阶段端到端生成任务,而非多阶段协同管理流程
key_insight: 模拟程序员在bug管理中的角色分工(test-developer-reviewer)可弥补LLM多步推理缺陷
method_signature: 三ChatGPT Agent模拟tester-developer-reviewer协作,四阶段(报告-诊断-生成-验证)迭代
evaluation_criteria: BFP基准上与SOTA LLMs对比pass@k和accuracy指标
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 实验仅针对单hunk Java bug且假设perfect fault localization,泛化性受限
evidence_for_taste: low accuracy, with performance rates below 15%
relies on pattern recognition rather than authentic cognitive processes
minimize the risk of information leakage
thinking_moves: 将bug修复任务类比软件工程中的bug管理生命周期
复用commit message作为程序员意图代理以避免信息泄露
用rubber duck debugging技术引导LLM进行代码解释
将LLM的pattern recognition局限转化为多Agent协同弥补
从软件开发流程中提炼协同行为模式并形式化
cites_own_work: Zhang et al. 2023 (Neural Program Repair with PDA)
